name: hue-status-light
description: Turn one Philips Hue colour light into a status light for all your Claude Code and Cowork sessions: purple = question, orange = permission prompt, red = failed test, green flash when a turn finishes.

cowork_mac_light.title: Cowork: drive the light through your Mac
cowork_mac_light.description: Lets Cowork sessions run ~/.claude/hue/hue-status.sh on your linked Mac through the Control your Mac osascript tool, once per session event, to set the light. Off by default; Claude Code sessions on your computer do not need it.
